card.name: Mixed spots before a number or measure
card.fires_on: Fires on a word or digit just before a value, rate or measurement is given. Examples are 'speed' in film speed, 'Temperature' in Debye Temperature, 'at' before a rate, and digits inside numbers like 1:1000 or 1998.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a ratio or year, such as the last zero of 1:1000 or a digit in a year.

modes.label: Property name before a value
modes.description: A measurable property word that is followed by a figure or unit.

modes.label: Word before a rate or process
modes.description: A linking or noun word that leads into a rate or an evaluation process.
modes.example: Dividends are usually set<< at>> a fixed annual rate that must be paid
